# OrbitControls

Copied from the project's installed three.js 0.186.0:
`node_modules/three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`.

Only the bare `three` import was changed to a local file URL so it runs in the Electron renderer without a bundler. Interaction logic is unmodified. MIT license retained in LICENSE.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
